channel.title: Dr. Innocent Nyalala — News & Publications
channel.description: Latest news, publications, and research updates from Dr. Innocent Nyalala, Assistant Professor of Data Science & AI at IIT Madras Zanzibar and Principal Investigator of SAAIL Lab.

item.title: CARA-FM Research Featured by AI4Africa — Weekly Research Spotlight
item.description: The CARA-FM framework for culturally attuned, resource-aware foundation models in East African agriculture was featured in AI4Africa's Weekly Research Spotlight, reaching researchers, policymakers, and communities across the continent. Work by Dr. Innocent Nyalala and Prof. Nirav Bhatt, presented at Deep Learning Indaba 2025.
item.dc:creator: Dr. Innocent Nyalala

item.title: Paper Accepted at ICLR 2026 — Trustworthy AI Workshop, Rio de Janeiro
item.description: SAAIL Lab's paper "Unifying Perspectives on Learning Biases: A Data-Centric Intervention for Holistic Fairness, Robustness, and Generalization" accepted at the ICLR 2026 Trustworthy AI Workshop. Authors: Patrick Vincent Ndowo & Dr. Innocent Nyalala.
item.dc:creator: Dr. Innocent Nyalala

item.title: Paper at 4th EAC STI Conference 2026 — Kigali, Rwanda · Travel Grant $980
item.description: In partnership with ZSTC, SAAIL Lab built the first AI-powered clove grading system on a novel Zanzibar dataset and won a $980 EAC STI travel grant to present "Deep Learning for Automated Clove Quality Grading" in Kigali.
item.dc:creator: Dr. Innocent Nyalala

item.title: Appointed as Editorial Board Member — Discover Artificial Intelligence (Springer Nature)
item.description: Honored to join the editorial board of Discover Artificial Intelligence, a Springer Nature open access journal, contributing to responsible AI, machine learning, and computer vision research standards.
item.dc:creator: Dr. Innocent Nyalala

item.title: Best Poster Award — Deep Learning Indaba 2025, Kigali, Rwanda
item.description: Winner of Best Poster Award (Publication & Dataset Category) at Deep Learning Indaba 2025 for CARA-FMs: A Framework for Context-Aware and Responsible AI in East Africa. Also presented at the Responsible AI Workshop oral session.
item.dc:creator: Dr. Innocent Nyalala

item.title: IIT Madras Zanzibar First Degree Distribution Ceremony Featured in Indian Express
item.description: Historic graduation ceremony as IIT Madras Zanzibar celebrates its inaugural MTech Data Science and AI batch, featured in the Indian Express.
item.dc:creator: Dr. Innocent Nyalala
